# Custom compose extension of the [relay specs](https://relay.dev/docs/guides/graphql-server-specification)

#region Scalars

scalar Timestamp

#endregion Scalars

#region Entities

#region General

interface Node {
  id: ID! # data
}

interface Entity implements Node { # Our own extension ontop of the relay specs
  id: ID! # data
  hash: String! # cached
  # owner: ENTITY # reference
  # ENTITYOwner: ENTITYOwner # computed
  entityOwner: EntityOwner # computed
  # owns: ENTITYConnection # computed
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed
}

interface EntityEdge {
  cursor: String! # computed
}

type PageInfo {
  hasNextPage: Boolean! # computed
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean! # computed
  startCursor: String # computed // start at this entity
  endCursor: String # computed // end at this entity
}

interface EntityConnectionInterface {
  # edges: [ENTITYEdge] # computed
  pageInfo: PageInfo! # computed
  hash: String! # cached // ur own extension ontop of the relay specs
}

interface WeakEntity implements Entity {
  id: ID! # computed // hash
  hash: String! # cached
  # owner: ENTITY # reference
  # ENTITYOwner: ENTITYOwner # computed
  entityOwner: EntityOwner # computed
  # owns: ENTITYConnection # computed
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed
}

interface StrongEntity implements Entity {
  id: ID! # data // uuidv7
  hash: String! # cached
  # owner: ENTITY # reference
  # ENTITYOwner: ENTITYOwner # computed
  entityOwner: EntityOwner # computed // ENTITYKIND
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed // ENTITYKIND
}

interface Artifact implements StrongEntity {
  # StrongEntity
  id: ID! # data // uuidv7
  hash: String! # cached
  # owner: ENTITY # reference
  # ENTITYOwner: ENTITYOwner # computed
  entityOwner: EntityOwner # computed
  # owns: ENTITYConnection # computed
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed
  # Artifact
  icon: String # data
  createdAt: Timestamp # computed
  createdBy: Author # computed
  authoredBy: AuthorConnection # computed
  changedIn: CheckpointConnection # computed
  lastChangedAt: Timestamp # computed
  lastChangedBy: Author # computed
  lastChangedIn: Checkpoint # computed
}

interface Document implements Artifact {
  # StrongEntity
  id: ID! # data // uuidv7
  hash: String! # cached
  # owner: ENTITY # reference
  # ENTITYOwner: ENTITYOwner # computed
  entityOwner: EntityOwner # computed
  # owns: ENTITYConnection # computed
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed
  # Artifact
  icon: String # data
  createdAt: Timestamp # computed
  createdBy: Author # computed
  authoredBy: AuthorConnection # computed
  changedIn: CheckpointConnection # computed
  lastChangedAt: Timestamp # computed
  lastChangedBy: Author # computed
  lastChangedIn: Checkpoint # computed
  # Document
  previewImage: File # reference // preview
}

#endregion General

#region Diffs

interface Modification implements WeakEntity {
  id: ID! # computed // hash
  hash: String! # cached
  # owner: ENTITY # reference
  # ENTITYOwner: ENTITYOwner # computed
  entityOwner: EntityOwner # computed
  # owns: ENTITYConnection # computed
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed
  # FIELD: NULLABLE FIELD // if the field was modified then return the modified value
  # removeNULLABLEFIELD: Boolean // use this if the field is by default nullable to indicate that it was removed
}

type ModificationEdge implements EntityEdge {
  cursor: String! # computed
  node: Modification! # reference
}

type ModificationConnection implements EntityConnectionInterface {
  edges: [ModificationEdge!]! # computed
  pageInfo: PageInfo! # computed
  hash: String! # cached
}

interface Diff implements WeakEntity {
  # WeakEntity
  id: ID! # computed // hash
  hash: String! # cached
  owner: DiffOwner! # reference
  ownerDiffs: Diffs # reference // spine
  changeOwner: Change # reference // spine
  operationOwner: Operation # reference // spine
  entityOwner: OwnerEntity # computed // DiffOwner
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed // DiffOwned
  # Diff
  before: Entity! # computed // diff
  modification: Modification! # computed // diff
  after: Entity! # computed // diff
}

type DiffEdge implements EntityEdge {
  cursor: String! # computed
  node: Diff! # reference
}

type DiffConnection implements EntityConnectionInterface {
  edges: [DiffEdge!]! # computed
  pageInfo: PageInfo! # computed
  hash: String! # cached
}

type Diffs implements WeakEntity {
  # WeakEntity
  id: ID! # computed // hash
  hash: String! # cached
  owner: DiffsOwner! # reference
  diffOwner: Diff # reference // spine
  operationOwner: Operation # reference // spine
  changeOwner: Change # reference // spine
  entityOwner: OwnerEntity # computed // DiffsOwner
  ownedEntities: OwnedEntityConnection # computed // DiffOwned
  removed: EntityConnection # data
  diffs: DiffConnection # data
  added: EntityConnection # data
}

type DiffsEdge implements EntityEdge {
  cursor: String! # computed
  node: Diffs! # reference
}

type DiffsConnection implements EntityConnectionInterface {
  edges: [DiffsEdge!]! # computed
  pageInfo: PageInfo! # computed
  hash: String! # cached
}

#endregion Diffs

input VectorInput {
  x: Float! # data
  y: Float! # data
  z: Float! # data
}

union VectorOwner = Plane | PlaneModification
union VectorOwned = Plane | PlaneModification

type Vector implements WeakEntity {

  id: ID! # computed // hash
